remarks: Welcome to 17 River Street - a 2000+ square foot townhouse tucked away on a private lot and on the market for the first time in almost 40 years. Filled with light from large windows and skylights, this spacious condo, on three separate floors offers 3 generously sized bedrooms and 3 full baths that have recently been renovated. With a one car attached garage, recently paved driveway, family room with soaring ceilings, west facing living room with a bay window and fireplace, adjacent to the formal dining room, this wonderful homes offers endless opportunities. There is plenty of parking and sidewalks to downtown New Canaan Enjoy all of the wonderful activities New Canaan has to offer. Come visit 17 River Street today!
